name: 2.3.Verify Page redirections Under Header from News Detail AMP Page
fullName: 2.3.Verify Page redirections Under Header from News Detail AMP Page
description:
[Edge] Verify that the AMP-specific sidebar navigation (AMP pages render a `.ampSidebar` in place of the normal header) as rendered on a News Detail AMP page (tractor-news/feb-2025-domestic-tractor-sales-report-59165-units-sold/?amp=1) loads successfully and every sidebar link (`.ampSidebar a`) resolves without a 404 or 500 error, with correct trailing slashes on internal links.

Expected: The AMP-specific sidebar navigation (AMP pages render a `.ampSidebar` in place of the normal header) as rendered on a News Detail AMP page should load successfully (HTTP 200) and every in-page link in scope should resolve to a valid destination — no broken (404) or server-error (500) links, and internal links should end with a trailing slash.
